verifier_extras.why_it_is_a_finding: build_builtin_registry registers the physics verifiers as *unavailable* when Pint is absent and list_all() returns them anyway, so a verifier set chosen by reading the registry looks complete while half of it errors; fifty of the hundred would have scored zero as 'undecidable' and the 70 % exit would have read as capability rather than as a missing extra

why_w0_proceeds_anyway: §3.1 has the fixture-scale slice run before the real model is touched, so every W0 deliverable except the model itself is reachable while the clearance is outstanding — which is exactly how 22C finished a W0 whose source gate was still open
